$comment: Brand settings for XOOTEQ. Edit, then run `npm run build`. Choices are proposals awaiting the user's approval (see campaigns/launch/brief.md for the one-line reasons).
name: XOOTEQ

color.$comment: Palettes by combination number (1-348) from Sanzo Wada's A Dictionary of Color Combinations; browse them in the brand hub (Colour tab). "primary" is the default (--<prefix>-bg, -ink, -accent ...). mode "light" puts the lightest colour in the background, "dark" the darkest. status: "placeholder" until the palettes are chosen, then "chosen". Proposal: 207 (Glaucous Green, Black, Sudan Brown): a sage ground for the 'organic' half of the tagline, black ink, and an earth-brown accent for soil. 'night' is the same combination in dark mode (Wada Black ground, glaucous green text), the closest the Wada palette gets to the site's near-black and green look.

typography.$comment: A pairing id from foundations/typography/source/pairings.json; compare them in the brand hub (Typography tab). scale is the ratio between type sizes (1.2 calm, 1.25 balanced, 1.333 bold). hand (optional) is one handwritten accent face from foundations/typography/source/handwritten.json, if the style allows it (approaches/<approach>/typography.json -> handwritten). Proposal: bricolage-figtree (core in Humanist Minimal), the closest core pairing to the site's Syne + DM Sans. No hand face: a technology R&D company is not the warm, personal case the guide reserves it for.
